name: Hu tieu pizza
summary: Hủ tiếu pizza is a pizza made from hủ tiếu noodles, served at the noodle workshops. Try it after watching the noodle sheets cooked, dried, and cut.
origin: The hủ tiếu workshops at Mỹ Khánh, toward Phong Điền.
howToEat: Order it at the workshop after the noodle-making visit.
where: The noodle workshops toward Phong Điền and Mỹ Khánh.
seoTitle: Hu tieu pizza in Can Tho
seoDescription: Pizza made from hủ tiếu noodles, eaten at the Can Tho noodle workshops after the sheets are made.
